accounting.rationale: PDF130 permits a reference without an effective argument for an OPTIONAL dummy. Exact actual/dummy correspondence, presence and permissible absent uses remain15.5.2; this does not define presence solely by effective-argument existence.
No actual is required in the admitted reference; zero or one actual correspondence and all absent-use restrictions still apply. It is not permission for duplicate actuals or an absent required dummy.
The PRESENT note is explanatory. Use the normative16.9.163 result and15.5.2.13 presence definition, not a new test equating presence with allocation, association or effective-argument existence.
PRESENT accepts the accessible OPTIONAL dummy's name and has no other argument requirements under16.9.163p3. It is not an arbitrary expression or component inquiry.

15.5.2.4p5/p6 distinguishes a present IN data-pointer dummy pointer-associated with a nonpointer target actual from argument association/effective argument. The note's informal wording cannot override the normative presence rule.
16.9.163 owns the LOGICAL scalar result and true/false semantics. Attribute permission controls are not new PRESENT effect owners or a reason to retag existing witnesses.

requirements.title: An OPTIONAL entity must be a dummy argument
requirements.definition: An entity with OPTIONAL must be a dummy argument. Eligible dummy data objects and dummy procedures retain their other attribute/interface rules. Unlike INTENT's procedure restriction, this does not require every optional dummy procedure to be a procedure pointer.

pending.data-dummy-admission: PENDING complete ordinary INTEGER, eligible data POINTER and ALLOCATABLE dummy declarations with OPTIONAL. If invoked, provide the required explicit interface and valid presence/state handling. No inquiry of absent or unavailable data is made.
pending.procedure-dummy-admission: PENDING an ordinary nonpointer dummy procedure and a compatible dummy procedure pointer with OPTIONAL. No INTENT attribute is added to a nonpointer dummy procedure. A missing callback is never invoked, and pointer calls require established association.
pending.nondummy-exclusion: PENDING an otherwise ordinary local data variable and separately qualified local procedure entity with OPTIONAL, repaired only by removing the attribute or establishing a valid dummy-list role. Keep actual role/cause and legitimate header/declaration origins distinct from unsupported procedure syntax or another attribute conflict.
pending.entry-and-attribute-source-boundaries: PENDING exact procedure/ENTRY scoping and attribute combinations, preserving alternate-return grammar and the fact that an unnamed asterisk is not a declarable dummy name. Elemental, interoperability, passed-object and other restrictions retain their canonical owners.

requirements.oracle: Complete eligible data/procedure admissions and minimally repaired nondummy declarations, with source-specific role diagnostics.
requirements.oracle_limitation: Required reporting capability is not fatal exit, standardized wording or a printed code. No broad INTENT-style procedure-pointer limitation is imported, and unrelated attribute/interface failures cannot qualify.

requirements.title: OPTIONAL permits a procedure reference without an effective argument for the dummy
requirements.definition: An OPTIONAL dummy need not have an effective argument in a procedure reference. This admission is subject to exact argument correspondence, an explicit interface where required,15.5.2.13 presence/absence and permitted-use rules, and the dummy's other attributes. It is not a definition that presence, allocation, pointer association and having an effective argument are equivalent.

pending.omitted-data-actual: PENDING a complete internal/module procedure with an ordinary OPTIONAL data dummy, called both with a defined actual and without it. Meaningful separate outputs/events distinguish both paths. Use IF(PRESENT(...)) control flow before any data use; a logical .AND. is not a guaranteed short-circuit guard.
pending.positional-keyword-omission: PENDING trailing omission and omission before later keyword actuals, with the keyword names from the accessible explicit interface and the reduced dummy list under15.5.2.1. Empty comma placeholders or omitted required actuals are not valid omission controls. Numbered actual-list diagnoses keep their own owners.
pending.dummy-category-controls: PENDING omitted eligible ALLOCATABLE, data-pointer, nonpointer dummy-procedure and procedure-pointer actual contexts. Presence checks do not permit dereferencing, invoking, allocating or changing an absent dummy. Complete controls retain valid interfaces and do not presume initial pointer status.
pending.forwarded-absence-source: PENDING canonical15.5.2.13p1/p3/p4 relations for forwarding an absent optional dummy to an optional recipient. Preserve exceptions, subobject-selector exclusions and pointer/allocatable recipient-category restrictions. No duplicate actual or arbitrary forwarding to a required dummy is admitted.
pending.presence-state-source: PENDING the exact absence branches for an unallocated allocatable or disassociated pointer actual corresponding to a dummy without those attributes, versus present attributed dummy contexts. Use normative16.9.163 for PRESENT and its name/host-accessibility condition. Unallocated, disassociated, undefined and absent are not interchangeable states.
pending.conditional-nil-source: PENDING source/fixture relations to15.5.1 R1526-R1528/C1540-C1545 and15.5.2.3: a chosen .NIL. yields a not-present actual. Every consequent-arg still meets the dummy's evaluation-independent type/kind/attribute requirements. Do not treat .NIL. as a standalone null pointer or skip unchosen-consequent constraints.
pending.present-without-effective-argument: PENDING a valid optional IN data-pointer dummy with a present nonpointer target actual under15.5.2.8p2.15.5.2.4p5/p6 gives pointer association but no argument association/effective argument;15.5.2.13 still makes the dummy present. Preserve this terminology boundary without turning the informative note into a contrary PRESENT oracle.

requirements.oracle: Meaningful omission/admission positive controls and finite canonical correspondence/presence/source relations. Independently known outputs are observed only after genuine presence and state guards; PRESENT effects retain their intrinsic owner.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No new mandatory rejection follows from this permission. An invalid absent-object use has no prescribed value or trap. Existing effect witnesses are not cloned or retagged as positive controls, and unsupported source/role mechanisms remain explicitly pending.

review_rationale: Independent original-source review87efa687790ffb131c1952cf92b57242d479db5969c23a96c58c64a41c3755e2, registered in doc/source_audits/batch_054.json. All3base/9fine units and two requirements retain11pending facets. C851 admits eligible ordinary dummy procedures without importing INTENT's procedure-pointer condition. Omitted/keyword/forwarded/conditional .NIL. references retain exact interface/correspondence/state and all conditional-argument constraints, including C1538/C1539 andC1540-C1545. PRESENT uses normative presence, not allocation, pointer association or effective-argument existence; the IN-pointer/nonpointer-actual distinction is retained. The note stays informative, with no absent-object access, short-circuit assumption, role retagging or duplicated PRESENT effect.
